name: Red's Smart Room
summary:
# You vs AI

A rogue artificial intelligence has seized control of your room and identified you as a threat to be eliminated. 

**Your objective:** survive.

The AI deploys an escalating arsenal of hazards: lasers, autonomous cleaning robots, turrets, mines, explosive devices, surveillance systems, and more. The environment grows increasingly hostile as each new threat remains active.
